summary: Fixed the POST /api/sessions handler in the backend: a merge had left a duplicated, dead copy of the session-creation code after the error handler, referencing variables that no longer exist (including 'engine'). That dead copy also silently dropped the 'Supported Coverage' selection customers pick in the New QA Run dialog. The duplicate is removed and the coverage selection is now saved correctly on every new QA run.
build_ref: worktree at b68a549 (NIHARIKA = origin/DEV tip); fix in server/app.js + server/app.test.js not yet committed/published
known_limitations: Change is not yet published to the shared repo; session creation on production deployments will only reflect this once published and deployed.
One stale temp file (.qase/sessions.json.tmp-67) cannot be deleted due to a filesystem error; it is inert and unrelated to this fix.
what_was_done: Removed the duplicated dead code block after the error handler in POST /api/sessions (the block referencing the out-of-scope 'engine' variable).
New QA runs now save the coverage selection from the 'Supported Coverage' panel of the New QA Run dialog (previously silently discarded for standard QA runs).

Kept the existing behavior: no coverage selection selected means full coverage; duplicate/unknown selections are tidied up automatically; an entirely malformed selection is tolerated rather than failing the run.
what_was_tested: New automated regression test covering the coverage selection on standard QA runs (saved, round-trips when re-opening the run, duplicates/unknowns tidied, no-selection stays legacy full coverage).
Full backend API test suite (37 tests) and security-regression + session-store suites (23 tests) all pass.

Live end-to-end on the preview site: registered a probe account, created a QA run with a coverage selection — run created successfully (HTTP 201) and the selection persisted exactly as chosen. Probe account and run cleaned up afterwards.

test_results.name: Regression test: standard QA run creation persists a whitelisted coverage scope selection
Live preview: QA run creation with coverage selection (201, persisted)

notes: Root cause: an earlier merge placed one parent's scopeSelection block after the other parent's handler catch, outside the try scope — dead code referencing undefined variables (would throw ReferenceError: engine is not defined if ever reached; in practice it was unreachable but suppressed coverage persistence).
SMTP setup for the password-reset flow remains pending until the customer supplies credentials (ticket #15673 stays in progress).
review_checklist: Open the New QA Run dialog, check a few 'Supported Coverage' items, start the run — reopen the run detail and confirm the coverage selection is still shown.
Start a QA run without touching the coverage panel — confirm it behaves as before (full coverage).
